WITH RECURSIVE edges AS (
  SELECT caller_symbol_id AS src, callee_symbol_id AS dst
  FROM code.calls
  WHERE call_kind = 'direct'
    AND callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL
    AND caller_symbol_id LIKE 'httpx/_client.py::%'
    AND callee_symbol_id LIKE 'httpx/_client.py::%'
),
reach(symbol_id) AS (
  SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols
  WHERE file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' AND qualname = 'Client._send_single_request'
  UNION
  SELECT e.src FROM edges e JOIN reach r ON e.dst = r.symbol_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT r.symbol_id AS symbol_id
FROM reach r
WHERE r.symbol_id <> 'httpx/_client.py::Client._send_single_request'
ORDER BY symbol_id
